 Falling for Hwang In Youp: His Candid Thoughts on Love, Growth, and Dreams
 By  Abby  |  October 30, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Subscribe Google Whatsapp Pinterest Digg Reddit Stumbleupon Vk Weibo Pocket Tumblr Mail Meneame Odnoklassniki 
 It’s Not Surprising How Hwang In Youp Remarkably Carved His Presence as One of the Go-To Lead Actors of His Generation!
 His nuanced portrayals, whether in small or supporting roles, did not go unnoticed. These eventually led to his well-deserved acquisition of beloved lead characters in popular and critically acclaimed Korean dramas.
 Through his successive projects, he has brought life to interesting drama characters that resonate with viewers. Inevitably, he also induces doses of heart flutters for his female fans.
 Preparing to meet his overseas followers, he is scheduled to meet his Filipino fans on October 31, 2026 for 2026 HWANG IN YOUP FANMEETING TOUR To You at the New Frontier Theater.
 • Hwang In Youp Reunites With Filipino HIYILY Through 2026 Fanmeeting Tour “To You” 
 Tickets are still selling on Ticketnet.com.ph! Make sure to score your ticket soon.
 Now, if you have secured your ticket to finally meet your dream actor, get to know him more with this feature!
 Constant Personal Progress
 Compiling a few skills in martial arts and sports, Hwang is keen to portray varying roles by equipping himself with multiple talents and expertise. Admirably, the actor aspires to become the best version of himself.
 “I want to become a person who is not embarrassed by any situation. I want to be a seasoned person who always leads the situation confidently and wisely.” 
 On Choosing Friendship Over Love
 In True Beauty , Hwang In Youp decorated the dashing Han Seo-jun with adorable bravado.
 He is one-third of the trio who shed light on how to use the right kind of bravery in complicated situations. More than that, we learned how friendships, once forged, can only be broken mutually.
 Responding to an interview with W Korea in 2021, the actor shared his thoughts on confronting a love triangle in real life.
 “ If you choose friendship, you will only lose love, but if you choose love, you will need to be prepared to lose both.” 
 On Respecting Mentors
 Confidence truly emanates from Hwang In Youp. Admitting that he wants his impression to convey his resolute attitude, he shared a simple but profound message that proves he is also grounded.
 In an interview with Arena Homme Plus Korea, he acknowledged the valuable lessons he could learn from the people he encounters.
 “ Everyone around me right now is my mentor.” 
 Wise beyond his years, Hwang’s gracious attitude is worth commending.
 Focusing On Career
 The cost of celebrity fame could be overwhelming sometimes. Relaying his thoughts on the challenges of building a career, Hwang In Youp confessed to choosing not to overthink.
 “I think it helped that I tried to be honest without rationalizing it. I want to flow naturally and harmoniously as much as possible.” – Marie Claire Korea 
 At times when the workload is too much, we tend to overthink if the job is really for us. The actor’s pragmatic approach teaches us the importance of being sincere and acknowledging what makes us happy in our careers.
 On Braving New Career Choices
 Debuting as an actor in his late 20s, Hwang In Youp confronted the roles given to him with utmost dedication.
 Regardless of whether he plays a student role like in The Sound of Magic , he focuses on the silver lining provided by such opportunities. Like how he won’t be able to wear school uniforms forever as his acting career progresses.
 “I thought about how much more I could wear school uniforms in the future. I thought that I could leave the most beautiful image of myself, so I filmed it happily. As an actor, I feel great and blessed enough just to be able to perform what I want. Working on success is something I’m grateful for.” 
 On Embracing His True Self
 Behind Hwang In Youp’s striking gaze and often cool on-screen image lies a personality that is much warmer than what viewers might initially expect.
 In his Dazed Korea pictorial and interview in December 2021, the actor reflected on how people perceive his appearance and how it differs from his actual personality.
 He explained that he had initially been cast in roles that carried a cold impression. However, he wanted people to recognize that there was more to him than his intense eyes.
 When asked what best represented the Hwang In Youp identity, he shared:
 “A heart that believes in me without comparing and not doubting what I have.” 
 Confidence, for the actor, is not about competing with others but about trusting his own decisions without constantly questioning himself.
 It is a refreshing perspective from someone whose popularity continues to grow. Sometimes, the best way to move forward is to believe in the person you are becoming.
 On Protecting His Passion for Acting
 As his acting portfolio continues to expand, Hwang In Youp also recognizes the importance of protecting the passion that brought him into the entertainment industry.
 In a Marie Claire Korea interview in July 2022, the actor revealed how his perspective on acting had evolved over the years.
 He shared that acting had become more than something he simply found fun. It had grown into something he genuinely loved and felt fortunate to pursue.
 “I think it’s important to protect myself well in order to maintain my feelings of liking [acting] so much that I feel fortunate to be an actor.” 
 He also expressed his hopes for the characters he would portray in future projects.
 “I hope that my sincerity will be able to reach the people who see the project and that they know that I tried to express [the role] with all my heart.” 
 His words reflect a thoughtful approach to his craft. Beyond the recognition and opportunities that come with being an actor, Hwang values the sincerity he brings to every character.
 On Believing in Himself
 One of the most meaningful revelations from Hwang In Youp’s Marie Claire Korea interview in 2022 was his willingness to acknowledge that self-confidence is something he continuously works on.
 The actor admitted that he was not always someone who naturally believed in himself. In fact, he recalled childhood experiences when he would often be among the last ones chosen during team selections.
 As he grew older, however, he developed a desire to become someone others could count on. He realized that believing in himself was an important part of making that happen.
 In the interview, he shared his determination to trust himself as much as possible and gradually expand the limitations he once placed on himself.
 “I try to cherish myself. I cherish my health and my words. I try to constantly reflect on myself, maintain good manners, and love as much as possible without easily hating anything.” 
 What makes this perspective admirable is his recognition that personal growth does not always happen overnight. Sometimes, it begins with the simple decision to give yourself another chance.
 On Finding Comfort in Personal Space
 Despite being surrounded by people through his acting projects and growing popularity, Hwang In Youp also understands the value of spending time alone.
 In the same Marie Claire Korea interview, he talked about how interacting with numerous people during filming could sometimes make it difficult to distinguish between himself and the characters he portrays.
 Having personal space allows him to reconnect with his own thoughts and understand himself better.
 He also shared his enjoyment of ordinary activities, including taking walks, going for drives, and washing his car.
 Interestingly, the actor revealed that he sometimes preferred to step away from excessive information and social media to find a little more peace.
 For someone whose profession requires him to constantly express emotions and interact with others, finding moments of quiet is certainly a worthwhile practice.
 On Becoming an Inspiration to Others
 More than simply wanting to become a successful actor, Hwang In Youp hopes that his career will eventually inspire other people pursuing creative professions.
 During a November 2024 interview reported by SBS Star, the actor talked about the kind of performer he aspires to become.
 Interestingly, he expressed his admiration for actor Jo In Sung, whom he considers an inspiration in terms of appearance, acting, and career trajectory.
 Hwang recalled watching Memories in Bali during his middle school years and dreaming of becoming an actor.
 When asked what kind of actor he wanted to become, he responded:
 “I want to become an actor who can inspire people working in creative fields.” 
 He further expressed his hope that someday, even one person might look up to him and find inspiration in his journey.
 It is a beautiful reminder that success is not measured solely by the number of projects or accolades an actor receives. Sometimes, making a difference in another person’s dreams is just as meaningful.
 Limited tickets are still selling, so make sure you book your tickets now and see Hwang In Youp in person!

 Source/Photos: W Korea | Marie Claire Korea | Arena Homme Plus Korea | Dazed Korea | SBS Star | Netflix
 Additional editorial notes
 I recommend keeping these five additions:
 • Embracing His True Self – Dazed Korea: Adds a more personal side to his public image.
 • Protecting His Passion for Acting – Marie Claire Korea: Strengthens the article’s career-focused message.
 • Believing in Himself – Marie Claire Korea: One of the most meaningful interview revelations.
 • Finding Comfort in Personal Space – Marie Claire Korea: Adds depth to his personality.
 • Becoming an Inspiration to Others – 2024 interview: Gives the feature a more mature and forward-looking conclusion.
 One important publishing consideration: Your original article refers to the June 19, 2022 Manila fan meeting. If this is intended for a new publication rather than an update to the original historical article, the event introduction, ticket links, and closing call to action should be revised.
 Also, the 2024 SBS interview identifies the publication only as a fashion magazine, so I have deliberately not attributed it to a specific magazine without confirmation.
